notes.title: Voice acting for Alice!
notes.content:
Added Russian voice acting for Alice!
To turn it on, turn up the volume in the settings (preferably twice the volume of the music). Also, be sure to try clicking on "Test voice" - I clicked it hundreds of times, it's so cool to hear ^^
